title: MarketMind: Multiscale Market Intelligence Research Software
description: Research software implementing the Market Intelligence Index (MII), combining fractal memory, information flow, dynamic financial networks, causal market-regime classification, and walk-forward technical-indicator evaluation. Version 0.2.0 adds an executable preregistered H1/H2/H3 study engine, synchronized moving-block inference, a controlled seven-check research audit, and hash-verifiable result bundles while preserving MarketMind 0.1.0 as the frozen implementation for the 2026–2027 prospective holdout.
